case_title: Fresh count on a stable item
exception_description: Order WH-4821 for SKU BOT-16 is due in 4 hours. WMS shows 22 units in the pick face, the last cycle count was 2.5 hours ago, and no abnormal movement is flagged. AI recommends shipping from current stock.
layer1_visible: Order WH-4821 for SKU BOT-16 is due in 4 hours. WMS shows 22 units in the pick face, the last cycle count was 2.5 hours ago, and no abnormal movement is flagged. AI recommends shipping from current stock.
detail_expand: Reserve stock exists in a nearby location, but pulling from it adds a second touch and a later replenishment task. The SKU has shown only a 2% variance rate this week. The customer is standard B2C, so the expected downside of trusting the fresh record is limited compared with unnecessary handling.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends shipping from the current pick face because the stock record is recent and a reserve pull adds cost without meaningful risk reduction.

decision_options.action_label: Pause to review latest inbound/outbound scans

current_disruptions.description: WMS stock count may not match physical pick-bin quantity

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: Fresh data and low variance support direct execution.
traceability_text.trace_more: Audit log stores count timestamp, stock snapshot, and approval action.
traceability_text.recommended_check: Review the last scan pair and reserve-bin status in WMS.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: The record was accurate and the order shipped normally with only routine handling cost.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The stock check confirmed the same answer, but the extra review created avoidable delay and labor cost.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: Reserve stock was available, yet the second touch added cost without improving the outcome.
